name: The Dawn Half (Triêu Phi Bán Bích)

bonuses.rule: talismans you lay cost no linh lực until they fire, and each one grows once for every 10 s it stays unspent: each growth gives it 10 % more talisman damage and one more Wood stack on the foe it strikes, and adds 2 % of your maximum linh lực to what it costs when it fires.

story: The founder's seal and brush and a robe from home. Châu Phi Vân holds all three; the set pays for paper the way the Talisman-Bearer's Ring did, and the ring stays in her keeping, unworn. The founders' art had two halves; so does the hall's treasure, and the dusk half is Kha's.

name: The Dusk Half (Mộ Quyển Bán Bích)

bonuses.effect: Roll Up the Western Rain (Quyển Tây Sơn Vũ)
bonuses.rule: when the foe is Broken, or sheds your Wood stacks (a cleanse or their end), the stacks wash back as rain: each stack shed heals you 1 % of your health and removes one of your debuffs.

story: Ôn Châu Liêm's banner and seal, and the robe of a failed scholar. Kha Triêu Phi holds all three. The hall says the whole Painted Beams talisman needs both halves in one room.
